title: OptimusVehicle
body:
The OptimusVehicle is a fast, big truck.

Details

The OptimusVehicle is the biggest vehicle, but it's not available for public. Instances of it can occasionally be found in testing servers, however, this was due to a previous incident.

Trivia

  • This vehicle maybe a reference from a certain character, specifically Optimus Prime from Transformers series.
  • OptimuVehicle maybe based on 1994 Peterbilt 379.
